name: Note Claim On-Create
description: before_tool_call hook that stamps a live-session claim on a memory/_note_*.md the instant a write/edit/apply_patch targets it — closing the last discipline-dependent sliver (a note first-edited mid-session before the model runs claim_note.sh). Observe-only: never blocks or rewrites the tool.

workspaceDir.description: Absolute path to the agent workspace whose memory/_note_*.md this plugin protects. If omitted, resolved dynamically from the target note path, OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE, the $HOME/.openclaw/workspace-<agentId> convention, or ctx.
